notFound.green-spot-algae: Searched green spot algae aquarium, Coleochaete, Coleochaete scutata, Chaetophora, algae aquarium glass, algae on aquarium plant leaves, Punktalgen, Algen Aquarium. Only microscope/herbarium Coleochaete images and book scans turned up, none that help recognise the hard green dots on glass.
notFound.green-dust-algae: Searched algae on glass, aquarium glass algae scraper, dirty aquarium glass algae, green dust algae, periphyton glass, Grünalgen Aquarium. Nothing showing dusty green film on aquarium glass.
notFound.fuzz-algae: Searched fuzz algae, Oedogonium, Oedogonium aquarium, Vaucheria, Rhizoclonium, Stigeoclonium, Ulothrix. Only microscope shots and old botanical drawings; no photo of short fuzz on leaves. An Oedogonium microscope photo exists (File:Oedogonium 183316612.jpg, CC BY 4.0) but it would not help a reader recognise fuzz on a leaf.
notFound.surface-film: Searched surface film water biofilm, aquarium surface scum, protein film aquarium, neuston film, oily film water, biofilm water surface, Kahmhaut. Only a brackish harbour mudflat biofilm (File:Biofilm sur eauPortAuray.jpg) and a puddle film (File:Kahmhaut.jpg); neither is clearly the same thing as aquarium protein film, so not used.
notFound.brown-algae: only a marine-tank photo where the brown film was unclear
